attributes.lede: Three sisters from New Orleans whose vocal arrangements changed what American popular music could sound like.
attributes.bodyLead: The Boswell Sisters recorded for Victor, Brunswick, and Decca between 1925 and 1936.
attributes.body: Their rhythmic feel, harmonic daring, and tempo-shifting arrangements influenced every vocal group that followed — the Andrews Sisters, the Pointer Sisters, Lambert, Hendricks & Ross, Manhattan Transfer.
